texts.1756572830: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Covert Helldiver reconnaissance has unearthed widespread Automaton mining on uninhabited Lava Planets. The Helldivers, completely evading detection thanks to their elite training, discovered evidence of ongoing operations on multiple worlds. These magma-covered planets are considered inhospitable to most forms of life. While details of the enemy's objectives are still unclear, the Helldivers have been ordered to immediately deploy to interdict these activities. Later: A new study shows that feeling unsafe or worried could be YOUR fault. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2727084642: Good evening, I’m your host, Coretta Kelly, with breaking news. In a shocking development, the anti-Democratic aliens known as the Illuminate have been confirmed as responsible for multiple simultaneous attacks across the galaxy. The advanced and highly xenophobic beings were thought exterminated in the First Galactic War. But according to the Ministry of Defense, their survival indicates that our children and our Freedom are now more at risk than ever before. The Helldivers deployed immediately in response to the Illuminate, and have already killed many of the intolerant, squid-like terrorists, while taking minimal casualties. That’s Liberty’s Latest; I’m Coretta Kelly.
texts.1983440210: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Reports indicate that the TCS, even partially activated, is proving effective, with Termicide killing 99.7% of the Terminids on the Barrier Planets. As the Termicide takes effect, the Super Citizen Prize for Science has been awarded to the brilliant researchers who developed the revolutionary chemical. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.158271980: Eagle Sweat. With an all-new formula containing 83% more sweat. Eagle Sweat. Don't just smell it. Live it.
texts.1389706302: The Automatons should have been content with what they had. Instead, they tried to take for themselves what the citizens of Super Earth had proudly built. Now, they're going to find out just how hard every man, woman, and child over 7 will work to stop them. Do your part: get to work!
texts.1232891664: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. If you choose to reload your weapon before the current mag is empty, those bullets end up wasted on the ground, instead of buried in the beating hearts of our enemies. I say: waste enemies, not bullets. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die trying.
texts.2349445081: It doesn't matter who you are or where you were born— all citizens are equal in the eyes of freedom. Which is why Super Earth's most patriotic minds instituted the Citizenship Classification Structure. Thanks to the CCS, we can determine exactly which citizens are the most equal. Continue your war efforts, and one day you too could reach Class A citizenship. The CCS: Liberty Optimized.
texts.3438092276: Good Evening, I’m your host, Coretta Kelly. Today, the mysterious cloud of spores known as “The Gloom” finally showed signs of slowing its growth. The cloud, which began emanating from the core of the Terminid Quarantine Zone last week, has doubled in size almost every day, and now encompasses nearly a dozen solar systems. All attempts to peer into the Gloom so far have failed, and military probes sent inside have all quickly ceased broadcasting. Experts speculate that the Gloom could be some kind of “mutation incubator,” supercharging the already extremely high rate of Terminid evolution. Currently, efforts are underway to construct a sturdier probe by insulating it in several layers of aluminum foil. That’s Liberty’s Latest; I’m Coretta Kelly.
texts.2085399875: The Automatons. Heartless killing machines. It is an undeniable fact that they do not have hearts. And heart is what Super Earth is all about. Prove your humanity. Show you care. Enlist in the Super Earth Armed Forces and destroy the Automaton threat!
texts.3890496416: Super Earth. Our home. Prosperity. Liberty. Democracy. Our way of life. But freedom doesn't come free. No… sweet Liberty… NOOOO! (laughs) Look familiar? Scenes like these are happening all over the galaxy, right now! You could be next. That is unless you make the most important decision of your life. Prove to yourself that you have the strength and the courage to be free. Join... the Helldivers. Become part of an elite peacekeeping force! See exotic new lifeforms. And spread Managed Democracy throughout the galaxy. Become a HERO. Become a LEGEND. Become a Helldiver!
texts.949395652: Freedom's Greetings; I'm Coretta Kelly. Tragedy has struck our Galaxy once more. A strange intergalactic phenomenon created by Illuminate Exospires has plunged entire planets into an impenetrable darkness. This strange area has been named "The Void." The Void neither emits nor reflects light, or any other known signal. Probes sent within have not returned. The Illuminate continue their construction of Exospires, which we now understand are the means by which the Void is created. When enough Exospires are constructed on planets near one another, they and the space between them become engulfed by the Void, and the planets are lost from sight. Facing this tragic threat, the Helldivers have been ordered to prioritize their efforts entirely upon the prevention of Exospire construction, as Ministry of Science experts race to discover more about this ethereal new threat. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.73452387: Good evening, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Further evidence reveals how the Illuminate used the Meridian singularity to enable their return. The destruction of the Terminid Supercolony earlier this year appears to have created a wormhole, which the Illuminate were able to use to force entry into our galaxy. Experts speculate that following the end of the first Galactic War, Illuminate refugees fled outside the Milky Way, trapping themselves in intergalactic space - until now. An investigation is underway to determine if the scientists responsible for the development of the Dark Fluid bombs used to destroy the Supercolony were secretly under Illuminate mind control the entire time. Coming up next: a teenager's homemade surveillance post finds dissident activity right in their own neighborhood. Stay tuned.
texts.3476671610: Freedom's Greetings. I'm your host, Coretta Kelly, with breaking news. The Automatons have just launched surprise invasions of multiple Developed Worlds. In response, the Helldivers have been partially redirected from Operation Valiant Enclosure to defend against the bot incursion. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3455315665: Good evening, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Today, fighting against the Terminids was bolstered by the arrival of the Helldivers, marking the start of Operation Valiant Enclosure. According to the Ministry of Defense, the Terminids will be safely quarantined once more by the end of the month. We go now to breaking news. We've just received what appears to be the first confirmed footage of the emerging Automaton threat. We're receiving word now that the President has released a statement, saying quote: "It is past time we responded to this unprovoked incursion against Democracy. The Helldivers are deploying as we speak to strike a number of Automaton military installations. These invaders will soon discover the steel of Super Earth resolve," end quote. With fighting on two fronts, this will be the largest Helldiver mobilization since the First Galactic War. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2267365187: Good Evening, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. What you're looking at here is recently-released footage from the Ministry of Defense showing an interstellar object that seems to resemble an Illuminate Void Ship. The Illuminate have long been considered eradicated following the First Galactic War, but this video is causing some to question if any somehow survived. Officials say they have not yet confirmed whether the object is truly Illuminate in origin, but that they are considering all possibilities. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.886349699: Freedom's Greetings, I’m your host, Coretta Kelly. Today, the Dark Fluid Research Facility on Moradesh went into emergency shutdown following what officials are describing as, quote: "a close call." According to reports, the volatile exotic material suddenly collapsed into a micro black hole that spaghettified 12 facility members before evaporating. Production of weaponized Dark Fluid is scheduled to resume tomorrow, with no shortfalls projected in support of the ongoing operation to destroy the Terminid Supercolony. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1019575676: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Today, Super Earth High Command announced the ultimate objective of Operation Free Space: the construction of a powerful defensive weapon known as the Star of Peace. Once complete, the Star of Peace is expected to usher in a new era of galactic security. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2450270221: Citizens of this great Federation, I come to you this evening with devastating, heartbreaking news. Our home, Super Earth, has fallen to the Illuminate invaders. Contact has been lost with all military forces remaining on the planet. The President and the Democratic Council are safe; they have been evacuated to a top-secret location, along with Super Earth High Command. The President has released a statement: "This is a day of unimaginable tragedy. But Managed Democracy is far greater than a single planet. So long as our citizens remain loyal to our way of life, Super Earth lives on." The Helldivers continue to fight, now shifting focus to establishing a temporary home and headquarters for our great Federation. This has been Coretta Kelly. May Freedom watch over us all.
texts.230392762: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Super Earth High Command declared the total victory of the Great Expedition, following the successful reduction of the Gloom's spread and the discovery of Element 711 on its planets. Now, the Helldivers have been deployed to support a new, even more ambitious plan to extract E-711 and use it to secure plenty of living space for all Super Earth's citizens. This plan has been named "Operation Free Space." While the Gloom will be allowed to continue existing, the Ministry of Defense has expressed high confidence in the Helldivers' ability to contain the amorphous space cloud. In other news, the heroic 10-year-old who turned in her own parents for dissident speech has become the youngest-ever recipient of the Super Presidential Medal of Ultra Freedom. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1358804309: Freedom's Greetings; I'm Coretta Kelly. Strange new activity on the Illuminate frontlines. Towers raised from ancient Illuminate ruins appear to be causing massive atmospheric disturbances known as "Exostorms." The Exostorms are believed to be only a side effect of the Exospire activity. Ministry of Science astronomers have observed gravitational "wobbles" between planets with Exospires—evidence of some sort of connection. The Helldivers have been deployed to interdict the Illuminate activity and prevent the construction of more Exospires. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.594248188: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a triumphant display of Democracy, the Star of Peace has successfully been activated in the defense of Super Earth. The Helldivers voted to defend our citizens by pre-emptively neutralizing a highly threatening planet harboring known enemies of Freedom. The space formerly occupied by the planet is now free from the Illuminate's totalitarian presence. All that remains is a highly-compressed boulder-sized mass, which is being kept under round-the-clock surveillance. Citizens across the galaxy have been advised to celebrate the newfound era of peace and prosperity ushered in by the Helldivers. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1831329940: The automatons have stolen something precious from us. Your mission: retrieve it. Or die trying. Of all the wonders humanity has achieved, the one that cannot remain in enemy hands is, without question: Eagle Sweat. With patented nano-fragrance technology that literally rewrites your DNA to make you smell like a hero of the federation. Eagle Sweat. Don't just smell it. Live it.
texts.3613655456: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. The Helldiver fleet has launched bravely into the Void, penetrating the depths of the exotic miasma for the first time since its appearance several months past. Many planets have disappeared into the Void since it was first created by the Illuminate. Intelligence on what lies within is scarce, but the Helldivers are undeterred, valiantly plunging into its depths to stop its spread, and destroy it. A Ministry of Science panel has determined the top three things the Helldivers are most likely to encounter within the Void: the Illuminate, uncanny phenomena that defy explanation, and a plot to murder every human in the galaxy. May Liberty guide them. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3830871816: They escaped the farms. They murdered good citizens of Super Earth. Now, they're coming for you. The only thing that can stop them? A strong economy! Don't let your family get murdered— spend your extra cash today!
texts.553052225: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. New updates on the backfiring of the TCS in the Meridia system. Here's the latest: A preliminary investigation by the Ministry of Science reveals that the Termicide initially worked, quote: "as intended," eliminating 99.6% of the Terminid population on all Barrier Planets. However, on Meridia, some of the remaining Terminids not only survived, but actually began reproducing up to 20 times faster than before. Scientists are now calling the planet a Terminid, quote: "Supercolony." The mutations caused by the Termicide appear to be random, but according to the report, it is only a matter of time before the same reaction appears on the rest of the Barrier Planets. The Helldivers may be in a race against time to deactivate the TCS before this occurs. In other news, the disgraced scientists who developed the Termicide have been taken into custody, and are to be investigated for dissident infiltration. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1326970417: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a triumphant display of Democracy, the Star of Peace has successfully been activated in the defense of Super Earth. The Helldivers voted to defend our citizens by pre-emptively neutralizing a highly threatening planet harboring known enemies of Freedom. The space formerly occupied by the planet is now free from the Automaton's collectivist grip. All that remains is a highly-compressed boulder-sized mass, which is being kept under round-the-clock surveillance. Citizens across the galaxy have been advised to celebrate the newfound era of peace and prosperity ushered in by the Helldivers. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3587970463: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. You will get shot at. But remember your ABCs and you will never die. Always. Be. Taking Cover. Because if there's one thing I've learned, it's that bullets do not go through cover. Assuming that cover is thick and largely impenetrable. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die trying.
texts.499884587: Good evening, I'm Coretta Kelly, with momentous, joyous news. We've just received word that Illuminate forces have withdrawn from Super Earth. The defense of Super Earth has succeeded; the battle is won. The valiant Helldivers, aided by SEAF soldiers, have saved our home. Days of vicious fighting have ended with the decimation of the once-Great Illuminate Host, last seen warping out of Super Earth's orbit. Multiple Megacities lie in ruins. The death toll of high-classification citizens is still being counted. This victory follows an unimaginable assault on Freedom, which will NEVER be forgotten, nor forgiven. The Second Galactic War continues, but today is a day of celebration. The shadow of Tyranny has been lifted from our great capital. Freedom shines brightly once more—thanks to the sacrifices of our greatest heroes. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly. May Freedom watch over you, and may Freedom watch over the Federation of Super Earth.
texts.928765842: This Liberty Day, become the patriot your family needs. When your children sprint to the Liberty Day Pyre to pull presents from the flames, make sure they get the gift they deserve. The gift of Helldivers. Because Super Earth isn't just about the heroes on the front. It's about the heroes right here at home.
texts.2553287619: Citizens of Super Earth, I come to you today with joyous, wondrous news. Super Earth, our home, is FREE once more. Following days of fierce fighting, the brave, heroic Helldivers drove off the Illuminate invaders, repelling them to the depths of the Milky Way. The President of Super Earth has released a statement: "We always knew this day would come. The light of Managed Democracy may be dimmed for a while, but it can NEVER go out—so long as our patriotism and fealty remain absolute." Displaced Class-A refugees return to homes destroyed, skyscrapers twisted into Illuminate abominations. Emergency funds have been diverted to ensure restoration efforts can proceed without delay. And, following a referendum to ensure the future safety of Super Earth, those suspected of dissident thought will now be automatically sent to the front lines. I'm Coretta Kelly; May Freedom watch over us, and may Freedom watch over the Federation of Super Earth.
texts.908660820: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Today, the Great Expedition launched its long-awaited voyage into the Terminid Gloom. The massive fleet of interstellar ships has an important mission: to find the source of the Gloom and destroy the interstellar spore cloud, once and for all. The Helldivers are leading the charge, ready to face whatever horrific monstrosities await in the mysterious miasma. To send off the Expedition, the Super Earth Children's Choir sang a stirring tribute to those lost in the New Hope City Massacre. In other news, an influx of new Helldiver recruits have been proving themselves on the front line of battle, already matching the high accuracy and low casualty rate of the most seasoned soldiers. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1758955071: My family has owned this same cabin for generations. Right here in Superstone Park. Which is why I choose Morgunson for all my huntin' needs. Like this SG-12 Breaker Assault Shotgun. Same as Pa. Now that... is what I call tradition. Hunting. Warfare. Home Defense. But most of all? Tradition. Morgunson: A Super Earth Company.
texts.2898491947: Good evening, I'm Coretta Kelly. The Meridian Wormhole has been safely collapsed with minimal consequences. The fearless Helldivers enabled the daring launch of the Democracy Space Station—converted into a giant nuclear bomb—into the center of the singularity, where it detonated with over 10 trillion megatons of explosive force. The controlled collapse of the wormhole prevented what could have been an unimaginable catastrophe. The scientists who determined how to collapse to Singularity have been awarded the Presidential Medal of Super Freedom. In a collective statement, they said "We were completely sure this would be safe. It's no surprise that it worked. We knew what we were doing." That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.4051168013: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. No Helldiver can Liberate the galaxy alone. That's why we have Team Weapons! One Helldiver shoots. Another reloads. Together, they create an unstoppable path of wanton Liberation! And don't worry, one stratagem comes with both weapon and reload pack. That's a 2-in-1 combo, soldier. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die trying!
texts.4078121478: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a shocking development, a massive Automaton fleet has invaded Cyberstan and the surrounding systems. Early reports indicate that this armada may be over 10 times larger than all previously encountered Automaton forces. Currently, there is no information about the source of these new Automatons, or their connection to the Automaton forces encountered previously. The unprovoked assault lasted merely hours, quickly overwhelming the relatively undefended planets on the Galactic Fringe. The President has already issued a response, saying "This attack occurred as we were nearing a permanent end to conflict with the Automatons. Now, it is clear that there can be no peace until every Automaton is utterly destroyed." The Helldivers have begun a counteroffensive operation with the ultimate objective of re-taking Cyberstan, the apparent base of Automaton operations. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.330662374: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. The Star of Peace has completed a successful test fire, collapsing a small moon into the size of a pebble. The defensive station fired a beam of atomized Dark Fluid into the celestial body, triggering a gravitational collapse. While deployment of Dark Fluid once created the Meridian black hole, extensive testing has shown the Star of Peace only presents a danger to Super Earth's enemies. The powerful new technology will be put to use imminently, following a Helldiver-led vote on where to defensively deploy the station. In other news: are inquisitive children more susceptible to Illuminate influence? Studies say yes, they are. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2401106311: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a shocking development, the Cyborg Legion has revealed itself to the Galaxy. In a cyber-terrorist attack, the Cyborgs hijacked Super Earth channels to broadcast a disturbing message. We will now play a portion of that video. Viewers are advised: this content will be extremely upsetting to all patriotic individuals. WE ARE THE CYBORG LEGION. WE WILL ENSLAVE YOU. WE WILL ERADICATE FREEDOM. BE ANNIHILATED. That was truly disturbing. The Cyborgs had been thought extinct following the Automaton invasion of Cyberstan. But this footage proves that not only did our former enemy survive, they were themselves the masterminds behind the Automaton invasion. The Government of Super Earth has voted unanimously to declare war on the Cyborgs. The Helldivers have been ordered to lead an offensive with the objective of liberating Cyberstan. I'm Coretta Kelly. May Liberty watch over us all.
texts.1460618997: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Today, citizens celebrate in response to reports of the first-ever reduction in Gloom spores. Helldivers deployed on a Terminid "Hive World" destroyed subterranean Gloom-producing bodies across the planet, leading to a reduction in spore density in the surrounding star system. This marks an auspicious beginning to the Great Expedition. Though much of the Gloom remains, a Ministry of Defense spokesperson expressed confidence that the Gloom could be fully dissipated as early as the end of the month. In other news: Recent reports cast doubt on the theory of swarm intelligence as ants fail to solve simple puzzles. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3737572021: Freedom's Greetings. I'm Coretta Kelly. The Ministry of Defense reports that a new seat of Managed Democracy has been established. The name of the planet has been distributed in secure channels. The planet will be the temporary capital of the Federation and Headquarters of High Command, until Super Earth is reclaimed. Super Earth refugees have been resettled on the same planet. And, some uplifting news: the first Managed vote since the loss of Super Earth took place earlier today. Citizens successfully passed a measure swearing eternal vengeance against the Illuminate for their unforgivable transgressions. From this new headquarters, High Command will direct the Helldiver campaign to reclaim Super Earth. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.851784003: This is Coretta Kelly, with an emergency broadcast. Super Earth is under attack. The Illuminate are invading. All citizens are advised to seek shelter immediately. Illuminate forces have launched assaults on each Mega City, including Prosperity City itself. Helldiver and SEAF units are engaged in fierce urban fighting on multiple fronts. Superstone Park has been destroyed. VHF Channel 1612 will broadcast up-to-date citizen alerts. This has been Coretta Kelly.
texts.4286828228: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly, with breaking news. A scientific breakthrough has been made using the strange liquid found on Terminid Hive worlds. This biological substance appears to be a more concentrated form of Element 710. Scientists have named it "Element 711." In a watershed moment for science, Element 711 has been successfully converted into Dark Fluid - the first-ever synthetic production of the powerful exotic matter. The Gloom is believed to contain vast reserves of E-711. The Helldivers have been ordered to shift their focus to maximizing extraction of the valuable resource. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2264036795: You crash on an uncharted planet. Stranded. Lightyears from Liberty. Then you hear them. They're almost on you, teeth gnashing, venom glistening in the twin moonlight. Suddenly you remember the one thing that can save you. Eagle Sweat. One spray, and the world shifts. You mount the beasts and rise, master of your domain, a god among the cosmos. Before long, you are home. Eagle Sweat. With patented nano-fragrance technology that literally puts odor molecules to the rack until they give up their secrets. Eagle Sweat. Don't just smell it. Live it.
texts.3876947490: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. Ah, the simple joy of unloading round after round into the bodies of your enemies. Oh, yeah. That's good... But if you get carried away... your shootin' days are over! Elite soldiers adjust their fire mode, so they can keep the killin' goin' all day long. Oh yeah, that's good. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die trying.
texts.3963584963: Good afternoon. Today, millions of citizens across the galaxy attended processions in memoriam for those lost in the Moradesh Dark Fluid Incident. As most viewers are likely aware, the planet of Moradesh was collapsed into a singularity following a disastrous meltdown at the Dark Fluid Research Facility. First responders continue to search for survivors, but due to the effects of time dilation, any escapees are unlikely to be found for at least 100 years. While investigators look into the cause of the incident, Helldivers continue to defend against the Terminid onslaught from the Meridian Supercolony, after efforts to destroy it failed last week. Meanwhile, scientists are working to develop a new and improved Termicide formula, giving hope for relief as the Automatons also continue to advance. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.4137735448: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. With Termicide Dispersion Towers now installed across the Barrier Planets, the Helldivers have begun operations to fully activate the Terminid Control System. The Termicide is reportedly proving extremely effective, with experts saying the benefits to the local ecology far outweigh the loss of some native species. After the break: a child with terminal radiation poisoning gets a surprise visit from their greatest hero. Stay tuned.
texts.3534847196: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. A recent report has shed light on the repulsive process by which new Cyborgs are created: Zygotes are harvested from a soup of human-like gametes, to then be placed into chambers filled with synthetic amniotic fluid. Following an accelerated growth process, a malformed humanoid is fused to a titanium exosuit. The newly-created weapon is then rapidly conditioned with anti-Democratic brainwashing, before being shipped to the front lines with orders to butcher any human it finds. While Cyborg DNA may match ours, there is no mistaking these monsters for anything resembling human. Up next: Have you ever seen a surfboarding turtle? This tubular terrapin says: "Hang 10." More on that, when we return.
texts.745076479: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. Hear that? That's the sound of heavy armor stopping the spread of Democracy in its tracks. See, enemies that are more heavily armored require you to be more heavily armed. Mmm, that's the stuff. With the right stratagem, there's no defense Democracy cannot penetrate. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die tryin'.
texts.527099185: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a triumphant display of Democracy, the Star of Peace has successfully been activated in the defense of Super Earth. The Helldivers voted to defend our citizens by pre-emptively neutralizing a highly threatening planet harboring known enemies of Freedom. texts.3737760211: And now, another helpful tip from General Brasch. Utilize Super Earth's call-and-response tagging system to communicate with your squadmates! Like this! Look, ammo. On it. Look, enemy. On it! Because, if there's one thing I've learned, it's that there is no liberation without communication. BRASCH TACTICS! Use 'em, or die trying.
texts.848624501: Good evening, I'm Coretta Kelly, with breaking news. The Illuminate Cult has triggered a catastrophic collapse of the Meridian Singularity, releasing a massive wave of Dark Energy that has destroyed multiple planets in its vicinity. Experts believe the Dark Energy radiation from the event could be even more destructive in the long run, affecting up to 60% of the entire galaxy. And, according to the Ministry of Science, the fabric of spacetime could be damaged in ways we do not yet understand. In a statement, the President said "Now is not the time to mourn; now is the time for Justice. We will mourn when our citizens are no longer threatened; we will mourn when Democracy is safe; we will mourn when every last Illuminate is purged from existence." Coming up: will listening to war stories during pregnancy make your baby more patriotic? More, after the break. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.300688129: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. The Helldivers are advancing on Cyberstan for the first time since the planet was seized by the Automatons at the start of the second Galactic War. Cyberstan, once a nexus of dissidence, has served as a center for rehabilitative labor since the end of the First Galactic War, when the Cyborgs were defeated. Now, we know the Cyborgs spent that time secretly plotting to once again destroy our way of life. And the Automatons have been nothing more than mindless cannon fodder for their Socialist overlords. Up next: "At Any Cost," an adaptation of the bestselling war memoir, is projected to break box office records this weekend. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1549761643: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. New information sheds light on the grisly aims of Automaton lava planet operations. Samples of a synthetic liquid being produced on these planets has been recovered by the Helldivers. Scientific analysis has revealed this biological fluid to be full of amino acids, nutrients, and stem cells - all apparently harvested from organic life forms. Disturbingly, scientists have verified beyond any doubt that the biological compounds were harvested exclusively from Super Earth citizens - the majority of whom might have almost certainly been small, small children. The Super Earth Association for Childhood Safety released a statement condemning the Automaton actions. Additionally, Automatons have been discovered to be mining large amounts of platinum ore. The Helldivers have been ordered to seize this material in order to prevent its use for socialist aims. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2492019753: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. In a shocking development, a massive fleet of Illuminate ships has appeared near the Meridian Singularity, seemingly having traversed the wormhole from somewhere unknown. This so-called "Great Host" of the Illuminate is believed to be ultimately headed for Super Earth itself. Our proud capital may soon become a battleground. Planetary defenses are being bolstered, with the help of volunteer civilians young and old who refuse to abandon the heart of Managed Democracy. Meanwhile, the Helldivers have deployed to engage the Illuminate force and slow its advance. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2398639649: Super Earth. Liberty. Democracy. Freedom. Independence. Voting. Liberty.
texts.4250367065: Managed Democracy: The freedom to make the right choice.
texts.4029698428: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Citizens of all ages and classifications are signing up to serve in what is now being called the Second Galactic War. According to reports, nearly 100% of able-bodied citizens have already voluntarily enlisted into the Super Earth Armed Forces. Meanwhile, those who are unable to fight are enthusiastically doing their part, making bullets, armor, toxic gas, and everything else needed for the Arsenal of Managed Democracy. Coming up next, an interview with the artist behind the smash hit "Can't Ration My Love." Stay tuned.
texts.4249888298: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Today, spontaneous military parades broke out across the galaxy, celebrating the destruction of the Meridian Supercolony. Thanks to the courageous efforts of the Helldivers, the planet Meridia was successfully collapsed into a black hole, destroying the Supercolony and its mutated strain of Terminids. Concerns of unforeseeable impacts from the use of Dark Fluid have proved largely unfounded, experts say, with only minor spacetime distortions observed in the area surrounding the singularity. Terminid spread has been vastly reduced following the planet's destruction, and efforts are now underway to develop a new and improved Termicide formula. Looking ahead, the Helldivers are also preparing to mount a counterattack against the Automatons. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2276156856: Good evening, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly, with breaking news. A shocking report from the Ministry of Science has revealed the true nature of the humanoid assailants being used by the Illuminate. These attackers have been confirmed as former Citizens of Super Earth, abducted and transformed into mind-controlled monstrosities. Captured specimens retain no trace of their former selves, showing no recognition of loved ones or the Super Earth flag. These lost souls have been named "The Voteless." Tragically, they are completely beyond saving. Citizens are advised to guard themselves against Illuminate mind control by redoubling their commitment to Democratic Values. As for the Voteless, the Helldivers have been ordered to bring a swift end to their horrific fates, as foot soldiers of a despotic regime. Up next: is ordering calamari patriotic, or evidence of Illuminate mind control? Stay tuned.
texts.2333850553: Freedom's Greetings, I'm your host, Coretta Kelly. Reports indicate that the TCS is fully operational, with Termicide having killed nearly 100% of the Terminids on the Barrier Planets. As the Termicide takes effect, the Super Citizen Prize for Science has been awarded to the scientific team that developed the revolutionary chemical. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.49069322: Freedom's Greetings; I'm Coretta Kelly, with joyous tidings. The Helldivers have liberated Cyberstan from the Cyborgs. For the first time in over a year, Cyberstan is free. The Cyborgs fled the planet, along with the Automatons, deeper into their territory. The Helldivers have already been ordered to pursue the enemy. Concerning reports indicate Cyborgs have already begun constructing new Megafactories on other planets, in a desperate bid to grow their numbers. The Helldivers have been ordered to destroy the Megafactories and eradicate the entire race of half-human monstrosities—in order to protect our children. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3560948686: Terminids. Unthinking monstrosities who want nothing more than to kill and eat every last human, and every last human includes your family. Don't let your family get eaten. Enlist today.
texts.2928276557: Freedom's Greetings; I'm Coretta Kelly, with grave tidings. The Cyborgs have repelled our heroic forces, retaining their hold on Cyberstan. Following a prolonged and hard-fought campaign, the Helldivers have been forced to withdraw. The Cyborgs, along with the Automatons, have launched a counter-offensive. Concerning reports indicate they have begun constructing Megafactories on other planets to create even more Cyborg soldiers. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.2218685337: Good evening, I'm Coretta Kelly. The Ministry of Expansion released an evacuation warning for planets near the Meridian Singularity, following a sharp spike in Dark Energy radiation. Experts believe that the wormhole has been held open by a constant flow of Dark Energy from the Illuminate invaders. Now, it appears that flow has ceased, resulting in an unstable singularity on the verge of catastrophic collapse. The Ministry of Truth states that "this is the latest act of vile escalation from the Illuminate Cult. Super Earth will not be terrorized by a spacetime-warping bomb." Citizens on affected planets are advised to report signs of Dark Energy radiation sickness, such as boils, floating, and loss of Democratic reasoning. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.1155808605: Hard work can get you there! That is the Super Earth promise. Put in your sweat. Put in your blood. Enjoy your patriotic responsibility. Prove your dedication to the betterment of our federation... And before you know it, you too will achieve your dreams. Super Earth. Freedom. Justice. Democracy... And dreams.
texts.1387219906: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. Discoveries in the mines of Cyberstan have shed light on the origin of the Automatons. Recovered prototypes indicate the Automatons were developed in secret by the Cyborgs during their rehabilitation. Worse, they derived Automaton prototypes from mining drones that were generously provided to aid in their restorative labor. Then, as we know, the Automaton prototypes were shipped off-planet in a stolen spacecraft known as "Vessel 00." The destination of that vessel remains unknown. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
texts.3786217212: Freedom’s Greetings, I’m your host, Coretta Kelly. Tonight's top story: In a historic collaboration between the Ministries of Expansion, Science, and Defense, Super Earth High Command is launching its first large-scale expedition into the Gloom. The spore cloud has grown to cover large portions of Terminid territory since its mysterious appearance. It has been described by Ministry of Science officials as “a biological abnormality created under extraordinary evolutionary pressure” and “spooky”. What it could be hiding has been the subject of intense speculation, but no theories have been confirmed. Now, the Helldivers have been entrusted with leading an expedition into this hostile environment. When successful, this initiative stands to revolutionize our understanding of Terminid biology. Coming up next: The teen cape craze, a sign of disrespect or a step towards enlistment? Stay tuned.
texts.1029002676: Freedom's Greetings, I'm Coretta Kelly. The Helldivers have deployed to the surface of Cyberstan, where they are engaged in fierce combat against the Cyborgs and their Automaton slaves. Cyberstan is the seat of the Automaton and Cyborg war machine. Its liberation could mark a turning point in the war against Socialist Terrorism. The Cyborgs, defeated by the Helldivers at the end of the First Galactic War, recently revealed themselves to be the masterminds behind the Automaton attacks. These malformed creatures were once human, but their hatred of Freedom twisted them into horrible, ugly freaks. The Cyborgs have constructed a series of Megafactories across Cyberstan. Reports indicate these factories are used to synthetically grow, and construct, new Cyborgs. Up next: do Cyborgs dream of electrocuting humans? An expert weighs in. That's Liberty's Latest; I'm Coretta Kelly.
